description: (Na)₂AgAsF₆ is High-temperature superconductor-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Na clusters inside a AgAsF₆ framework. In each Na cluster, Na is bonded in a 12-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the AgAsF₆ framework, Ag is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form AgF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent AsF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Ag-F bond lengths are 2.37 Å. As is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form AsF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent AgF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All As-F bond lengths are 2.05 Å. F is bonded in a linear geometry to one Ag and one As atom.
